answer: You can still sell us the car and pay the difference at your appointment, using a cashier's check or a debit card. We no longer accept personal checks, and we don't accept credit cards. Lakeshore Bank is in our e-payoff network, so you don't need a payoff letter. We confirm the payoff directly with them the same day at your appointment, using your loan account number. If you'd rather not pay the difference, you can keep the car, because an offer never obliges you to sell.
